text:
kay_docs: quick flag from nightly: console/observability/examples/route-latency-costs.md failed JSON schema because several dashboard exports used camelCase keys (`traceKey`, `unitCost`) instead of snake_case. CI: "unknown field 'traceKey'".

fern_engineering: ouch. which file? can you paste the snippet?

kay_docs: here: 
```json
{
  "widgets": [
    {
      "type": "trace",
      "config": {
        "traceKey": "trace.id",
        "unitCost": "metrics.unitCost"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
should be `trace_key` and `unit_cost` to match the dashboard schema export.

paul_sdk: also seeing Python and TS snippets below that call `render_trace_hook` and refer to `metrics.costPerToken` (camelCase). SDKs standardized on snake_case and `unit_cost` when we aligned with infra/schema v0.11.0.

maya_prod: the product export from the dashboard UI still uses camelCase in some regions; UX team said they're rolling a patch but it won't hit this week's release.

fern_engineering: two-pronged fix: update docs examples to canonical snake_case, and add a docs CI smoke check to detect common camelCase keys in exported JSON examples. we should also add a one-line note in migration.md about UI exports older than v0.11.0.

kay_docs: agree. i patched the Markdown examples and replaced the JSON export with a normalized version, marked the old export with a short comment: `# legacy: camelCase dashboard exports` so it's searchable.

paul_sdk: i'll open a micro PR to fix the Python/TS snippets and grep for `costPerToken|unitCost|traceKey` across repo. PR: #5123 - updates snippets for python/js, adds docs/deprecated_key_patterns.txt and a grep-based smoke check in scripts/docs_smoke.sh.

doc-bot: [ci/docs] build failed 5209876501 - jsonschema error: unknown field 'unitCost' in console/observability/examples/route-latency-costs.md

fern_engineering: pushed a follow-up commit to replace the remaining `unitCost` in a nested example. also updated the image caption in assets/route-latency-snapshot.png to mention the field rename so exported dashboards are easier to reconcile.

paul_sdk: added CHANGELOG entry under docs: "examples: normalize dashboard exports to snake_case; update SDK snippets to snake_case keys". left a TODO to coordinate with UX patch.

kay_docs: can we improve the smoke check to read `docs/deprecated_key_patterns.txt` rather than inline regex? makes it maintainable.

fern_engineering: done in PR; smoke script reads that file. added initial patterns: `traceKey`, `unitCost`, `costPerToken`, `renderTraceHook`. left comments with links to infra/schema#110 and UX ticket UX-789.

doc-bot: [ci/docs] build passed 5209876615 :tada:

maya_prod: nice! please add a short blurb in console/observability/migration.md explaining the export case changes and how to canonicalize older JSON exports (quick jq snippet?).

kay_docs: i added a small example using jq to transform camelCase to snake_case and a note linking UX-789. pushing in follow-up commit.

paul_sdk: LGTM. merging once CI green. let's monitor issues in the release notes so PMs know dashboards they exported might need small edits.

kay_docs: thanks all — great quick turn-around. will file a follow-up issue to sync with UX once their patch rolls out: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/478
